# WaitForIt v2.2.1 - Table of Contents

> Elixir library providing various ways of waiting for things to happen

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [License](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

- Guides
  - [Waiting in tests](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/waiting_in_tests.md)
  - [Polling vs signaling](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/polling_vs_signaling.md)
  - [Composing waits](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/composing_waits.md)
  - [Recipes](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/recipes.md)
  - [Telemetry](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/telemetry.md)

## Modules

- [WaitForIt](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/WaitForIt.md): 
- [WaitForIt.Backoff](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/WaitForIt.Backoff.md): Backoff strategies for the `:interval` option of the waiting macros.
- [WaitForIt.Test](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/WaitForIt.Test.md): Assertions for waiting on asynchronous and concurrent activity in ExUnit tests.
- [WaitForIt.Waitable](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/WaitForIt.Waitable.md): Protocol used for evaluating waitable expressions against waiting conditions to determine if
waiting should continue or halt with a final value.

- Deprecated
  - [WaitForIt.V1](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/WaitForIt.V1.md)

- Exceptions
  - [WaitForIt.TimeoutError](https://wait-for-it.hexdocs.pm/WaitForIt.TimeoutError.md): Exception type to represent a timeout that occurred while waiting.
